title: Sagittarius: what to know
description: The essentials of Sagittarius in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Sagittarius: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Nov 22 - Dec 21. Fire element, mutable quality, ruled by Jupiter.

pages.title: Optimism
pages.text: Sagittarius sees possibilities, loves to learn and spreads enthusiasm.

pages.title: Too frank
pages.text: Speaking without a filter can hurt without meaning to. A little tact keeps the honesty.

pages.title: Freedom
pages.text: Needs space and adventure. Likes a partner who grows alongside and does not cling.

pages.title: The one who expands
pages.text: Does well with travel, teaching, communication and projects that widen horizons.
